scope: Numerical aggregate correctness, coverage, immutable provenance and reporting interpretation. Source-use/process validity is separately reviewed; no causal skill-superiority inference.

independent_recomputation.method: Inspected independent NumPy OLS/residual, moment and quantile formulas. Uniform H weights are justified by independently asserted eight-cell counts of 375; L uses 38.67 conversion, same design and Pearson residual correlation. Verified exact coverage of all 513 comparison keys and numerical tolerances against EVALUATION.json.
independent_recomputation.comparison_tolerance: 1e-9 times max(1, absolute reported scalar), used only for floating-point arithmetic verification; not a clinical agreement or superiority threshold.

reviewer_checks: Verified every execution receipt hash against closure and report, every receipt-file hash, all 18 generated-CSV hashes, fixed seed/author identities, 3000 rows per receipt, success, confirmed generator entry and no failure class.

Verified batch-lock hash, preserved implementation-review binding, current reviewed controller/protocol hashes, seal-before-attempt and all-executions-complete-before-evaluation timestamps. EVALUATION_STARTED binds the same closure hash as the final report.
Checked exact ordered endpoint IDs/units against ENDPOINT_CONTRACT.json for all slots; all six primary analyses and every H/L diagnostic are retained.
Independently recalculated every signed/absolute discrepancy, sign classification, availability count, per-construction mean/range, mean deviation and sign count from report scalar values.

Verified reference entries are identical across all arms/seeds for the same endpoint. Only the two existing lipid sample-SD diagnostics are reference-comparable; the remaining 21 lipid diagnostics remain unavailable, producing 189 unavailable comparisons.
Verified supplied uncertainty stays attached to its own endpoint and all generated inferential intervals/SEs remain unavailable as declared by the generated-only providers.
Verified EVALUATION.md exactly matches the renderer applied to the bound EVALUATION.json and the completion-record hashes match both published files.

reference_uncertainty_interpretation.glycemia: Supplied endpoint-specific empirical cluster-resampling stability bands from 399 attempts; no national confidence-coverage or equivalence-margin interpretation. H standard errors are not supplied.
reference_uncertainty_interpretation.lipid_slopes: Supplied HC3 normal assumption-conditional sensitivity intervals with nominal level 0.95 and their reported standard errors; not design-based confidence intervals.
reference_uncertainty_interpretation.lipid_total_cholesterol_caution: The supplied TC-BMI interval includes zero, so agreement with the point-estimate sign is only descriptive.
reference_uncertainty_interpretation.lipid_residual_correlation: No supplied interval or standard error; no interval was inferred.
reference_uncertainty_interpretation.generated_seeds: Three draws from one fixed authored law per arm/case; seed ranges are not confidence intervals or independent-author replication.

limitations: Previously exposed clinical aggregate references are reused; this remains developmental agreement, not fresh clinical confirmation.
One author per arm/case confounds instruction condition with author and modeling choices; three seeds do not remove that confounding.
No causal improvement or general skill superiority is established; no overall quality score, clinical acceptance margin or winning-seed selection is justified.
Arithmetic correctness does not validate source transport, measurement equivalence, unsupported assumptions, population recovery or individual-row recovery.

No real patient files, original numerical-reference files or authored models were opened for this result review. Existing generated files were hashed; their scalars were independently recomputed by the inspected script. No regeneration or clinical-reference refit occurred.
The reviewer became exposed to aggregate reference values only during this postclosure reporting review.
